## Services

B&R Power Washing offers six service lines, each with the same crew standards, equipment, and care:

1. **House Washing & Soft Washing** — Low-pressure biodegradable cleaning solutions safely lift dirt, algae, and mildew from siding without damage. Recommended once or twice a year.
2. **Driveway & Sidewalk Cleaning** — Pressure washing for concrete, pavers, brick. Lifts oil stains, grime, and Houston humidity buildup.
3. **Roof & Gutter Cleaning** — Soft-wash treatments protect shingles. Gutter clears prevent water damage. Multi-story properties handled with full insurance.
4. **Window Cleaning** — Streak-free, frame included. Single-story to high-rise. Inside-and-out options.
5. **Commercial Pressure Washing** — Storefronts, parking lots, dumpster pads, restaurant exteriors, multi-family complexes, HOA common areas. Scheduled or one-time. After-hours and weekend service available.
6. **Patio, Deck & Fence Cleaning** — Wood gets soft-washed. Stone and concrete gets pressure-washed. Outdoor spaces ready for entertaining the same week.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How does the AI Quote Tool work?**
A: Upload or take a photo. Our AI analyzes the surface, estimates square footage, identifies whether soft-wash or pressure-wash is appropriate, and returns a real price range in 60 seconds.

**Q: What's the difference between soft washing and pressure washing?**
A: Soft washing uses low-pressure water with biodegradable cleaning solutions to safely remove dirt, mold, and mildew — ideal for siding, roofs, and other delicate surfaces. Pressure washing uses high-pressure water for tough stains on concrete, brick, or other hard surfaces.

**Q: How often should I have my home or driveway cleaned?**
A: Most Houston homeowners schedule exterior cleaning once or twice a year. High-traffic driveways and commercial properties may benefit from quarterly visits.

**Q: Are you licensed and insured?**
A: Yes — fully licensed, fully insured, including for height work on multi-story buildings.

**Q: Do you serve commercial properties?**
A: Yes. Storefronts, restaurants, multi-family complexes, dumpster pads, parking lots, HOA common areas, and recurring maintenance contracts. After-hours and weekend service available.

**Q: Do you use eco-friendly cleaning products?**
A: Yes — every solution we use is biodegradable and safe for landscaping, pets, and people.

**Q: What Houston neighborhoods do you serve?**
A: All of them. Greater Houston, every zip code. Including Memorial, River Oaks, The Heights, Tanglewood, West University, Bellaire, Galleria, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, Sugar Land, Pearland, The Woodlands, and Spring.
